entities.name: Chloronitroaniline
observations: Decoded reactant is Nc1cccc(Cl)c1[N+](=O)[O-], a chloronitroaniline.
The aryl chloride is retained in the reported product transformation.

entities.name: Chlorophenylenediamine
observations: Decoded product is Nc1cccc(Cl)c1N, the corresponding chlorobenzene-1,2-diamine; consistent with 3-chloro-1,2-phenylenediamine naming.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation is Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2 while retaining the aryl C-Cl bond.
Plausible net equation is Ar-NO2 + 6[H] -> Ar-NH2 + 2H2O.

entities.name: SnCl2 alcoholic reduction
observations: Exact ORD matches use stannous chloride with methanol or ethanol, water, and acid/base workup components for this chloronitroaniline-to-diamine transformation.
Exact reaction records are ORD ord-a0e49089397d41f0b76fdbf6208d7b2c and ORD ord-03ff6678f3d046f3aa7b90f03b3fb3db.
